parse_link: parse a reStructuredText link string into a title and URL using the link_regexp pattern
glext: create a Docutils reference node that links an OpenGL extension name to its Khronos registry page
webglext: create a Docutils reference node that links a WebGL extension name to its Khronos registry page
glfn: create a Docutils reference node that links an OpenGL function name to its Khronos reference page
glfnext: create a Docutils reference node that links an OpenGL extension function name to its Khronos registry page
register_mcss: register the glext, webglext, glfn, and glfnext local roles with the Docutils reStructuredText parser
